url.title: URL
url.description: The final URL that was scraped, after any redirects.

title.title: Title
title.description: The article or page title, when one could be detected.

excerpt.title: Excerpt
excerpt.description: A short summary of the page, when available.
excerpt.example: This domain is for use in documentation examples.

siteName.title: Source
siteName.description: The site or publication name, when available.

wordCount.title: Words
wordCount.description: Approximate number of words in the extracted Markdown.

markdown.title: Markdown
markdown.description: The clean, readable Markdown content. This is the main payload.
markdown.example: This domain is for use in documentation examples without needing permission.

scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
scrapedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the page was scraped.

error.title: Error
error.description: Present only when a page could not be scraped. Such pages are never charged.

overview.title: Scraped pages
overview.description: Clean Markdown for each page, with its title, source, and length.

errors.title: Failed pages
errors.description: Pages that could not be scraped. These are never charged.
